calculate_elastic_properties: calculate elastic tensor and modulus properties for atomic structures using an ASE calculator
run_elasticity_with_job_sharding: run elasticity calculations on a subset of structures using job_num and num_jobs for parallel execution
write_elasticity_results_to_json: write elasticity calculation results as a compressed JSON file to a specified results directory
convert_elastic_tensor_to_gpa: convert elastic tensor values from eV/Angstrom^3 to GPa using the eVA3_to_GPa conversion constant
handle_elasticity_calculation_errors: handle exceptions during elasticity calculations by capturing error messages and tracebacks in results
